shared: FASTK family proteins regulate processing and stability of mitochondrial RNAs
regulation of mitochondrial RNA catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial RNA processing and translation machinery
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial mRNA and rRNA modification, processing, stability and decay, together with mitoribosome subunit assembly. This is the core of mitochondrial gene expression, completed by mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial gene expression
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern mitochondrial RNA processing, stability, modification and mitoribosome assembly, framed as the post-transcriptional and translational stages of mitochondrial gene expression downstream of mtDNA replication and transcription.

shared: negative regulation of immature T cell proliferation in thymus
negative regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process
positive regulation of T cell differentiation in thymus
positive regulation of immature T cell proliferation in thymus

reading_1.theme: Control of thymocyte and hematopoietic cell numbers
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover thymic regulation of immature T cell proliferation, survival and differentiation. Here this is one instance of tissue cell-number homeostasis, paralleled by proliferation and apoptosis control in bone marrow.

reading_2.theme: Homeostasis of lymphoid progenitor numbers in thymus and marrow
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are about balancing thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation. Here they serve cell-number homeostasis across primary lymphoid and haematopoietic tissues.

shared: protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere

reading_1.theme: Telomere protection and maintenance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe telomere capping and protection from end-joining and t-circle formation, framed as preserving telomere ends while recombination and replication-based maintenance mechanisms act on them.

reading_2.theme: Telomere protection and maintenance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover shelterin-type end protection (capping telomeres, blocking NHEJ and limiting t-circle formation). This is the protective arm that sits alongside telomerase-mediated extension, C-strand fill-in synthesis and ATRX/DAXX-dependent suppression of telomeric recombination.

shared: Sodium-coupled sulphate, di- and tri-carboxylate transporters

reading_1.theme: Membrane transport of carboxylates and metabolic fuels
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame sodium-coupled uptake of succinate and other di-/tricarboxylates as one class of metabolic substrate transport, together with pyruvate, carnitine and glucose carriers, notably in the renal proximal tubule.

reading_2.theme: Dicarboxylate transport feeding glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover sodium-coupled uptake of TCA intermediates (succinate, citrate, alpha-ketoglutarate). Here they act as the supply of carbon skeletons and shuttle substrates for glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversion, the malate-aspartate shuttle and ammonium handling.

reading_1.theme: Epithelial solute transport, tight junctions and osmotic stress
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover magnesium and inositol transport and the multimeric assembly of membrane proteins that mediate calcium-independent adhesion. Here these serve epithelial paracellular/tight-junction solute handling and osmolyte accumulation in hyperosmotic stress.

reading_2.theme: Membrane transport of ions and osmolytes
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover magnesium and inositol transport and homeostasis plus oligomeric membrane protein assembly, framed as osmotic/ionic homeostasis via channels and junctional paracellular transport under salt stress.

shared: Developmental Lineage of Multipotent Pancreatic Progenitor Cells
Developmental Lineage of Pancreatic Endocrine Mid Progenitor Cells
Regulation of gene expression in early pancreatic precursor cells

reading_1.theme: Pancreatic endocrine lineage development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the progenitor stages of pancreatic lineage specification and their transcriptional control, the early steps leading to endocrine (and exocrine) cell differentiation.

reading_2.theme: Endoderm and pancreatic lineage specification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe pancreatic progenitor and endocrine lineage programs, framed as the pancreatic branch of endoderm development from definitive endoderm and foregut.

reading_1.theme: Somitogenesis and segmentation clock
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are somite segmentation and compartment patterning, including the LFNG/Notch segmentation clock whose defect causes spondylocostal dysostosis, extended by somite specification, rostrocaudal polarity and axis elongation.

reading_2.theme: Somitogenesis and segmentation clock
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe somite formation and segmental compartment patterning (including LFNG clock defects), framed as the core of somite specification, rostrocaudal polarity and axis elongation.

reading_1.theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways name broad organic-acid metabolism in mitochondria and peroxisomes with pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, read here as the peroxisomal/mitochondrial fatty acid catabolism spanning alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation of branched and very long-chain fatty acids.

reading_2.theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are generic organic acid metabolism and peroxisomal beta-oxidation of branched-chain pristanoyl-CoA, framed as the shared peroxisome-mitochondria fatty acid catabolism route that handles very-long, branched and medium chains.

shared: DNA synthesis involved in DNA repair
replication-born double-strand break repair via sister chromatid exchange

reading_1.theme: Recombinational repair of replication-associated DNA breaks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover repair DNA synthesis and sister-chromatid-exchange repair of replication-born double-strand breaks. These are recombination-based fork repair steps, together with strand invasion, SDSA, fork reversal, interstrand cross-link repair and DNA topology changes.

reading_2.theme: Recombinational repair of replication-associated DNA damage
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are repair DNA synthesis and sister-chromatid-exchange double-strand break repair, framed as homologous recombination used to rescue broken or stalled replication forks (fork reversal, strand invasion, crosslink and camptothecin damage).

shared: regulation of NK T cell proliferation
positive regulation of NK T cell activation
regulation of NK T cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: NKT cell and Th1-type IL-12/IFN-gamma immunity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways concern activation, proliferation and differentiation of NKT cells, framed here as innate-like T cell drivers of a Th1 response with IL-12 from activated dendritic cells and IFN-gamma production.

reading_2.theme: IL-12-driven Th1 and NKT cell immunity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are NK T cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, framed as an innate-like lymphocyte arm of the IL-12/IFN-gamma Th1 response initiated by activated dendritic cells.

shared: amyloid-beta clearance by cellular catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Amyloid-beta production, clearance and neural effects
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame amyloid-beta clearance and its regulation as the removal side balancing amyloid-beta production, with consequences for synaptic plasticity and microglial activation.

reading_2.theme: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cellular clearance of amyloid-beta and its regulation, opposing amyloid fibril formation and complemented by transcytotic clearance.

shared: RAS signaling downstream of NF1 loss-of-function variants
Gain-of-function MRAS complexes activate RAF signaling
negative regulation of ERK1 and ERK2 cascade
Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
Inhibition of TSC complex formation by AKT (PKB)

reading_1.theme: Attenuation and negative feedback of RAS-ERK signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the RAS-ERK cascade itself, from SHC/SOS activation and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K variants to its GAP, phosphatase and feedback brakes, framed here as the signal whose suppression and inactivation the theme is about.

reading_2.theme: FGFR-RAS-MAPK signalling and its oncogenic dysregulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the core RAS-ERK module with its feedback inhibition and RAS/MAP2K mutant signalling, framed as the common downstream hub fed by FGFR (and IGF1R) receptor activation and RAF mutants.

shared: response to cell cycle checkpoint signaling

reading_1.theme: Fanconi anemia interstrand cross-link repair and genome stability
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways (DNA stability, checkpoint response, deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated proteins) are framed here as the FANCD2/FANCI monoubiquitination-deubiquitination cycle and checkpoint coupling that govern Fanconi pathway repair of interstrand cross-links during S phase.

reading_2.theme: DNA damage response to replication stress
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are genome stability maintenance through checkpoint responses and deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated repair proteins, framed as replication stress tolerance alongside ADP-ribosylation, crosslink repair and double-strand break repair.

shared: protein localization to chromosome, telomeric region
Inhibition of DNA recombination at telomere
negative regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase
Defective Inhibition of DNA Recombination at Telomere Due to ATRX Mutations
protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere
Defective Inhibition of DNA Recombination at Telomere Due to DAXX Mutations

reading_1.theme: Telomere end protection and maintenance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the protected telomere state: capping, chromatin packaging, blocking NHEJ and t-circles, restraining telomerase, and ATRX/DAXX-dependent suppression of recombination. This state sits beside telomerase extension and C-strand synthesis.

reading_2.theme: Telomere protection, capping and alternative lengthening
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe telomere packaging, capping, NHEJ protection and ATRX/DAXX-mediated suppression of telomeric recombination, framed here as the protective restraint whose loss permits recombination-based (ALT) telomere maintenance and escape from senescence.

reading_1.theme: Rho family GTPase signalling to the actin cytoskeleton
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the CDC42, RHOG, RHOJ and RAC3 GTPase cycles, framed as the switch-level signalling that activates WASP/WAVE and Arp2/3 to build lamellipodia.

reading_2.theme: Rho-family GTPase signalling to actin protrusions
reading_2.core_role: The shared GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOG, RAC3 and RHOJ are the switching core of small-GTPase signalling that, through WASP/WAVE and Arp2/3, drives lamellipodia and actin-based protrusion.

shared: positive regulation of focal adhesion assembly
positive regulation of stress fiber assembly

reading_1.theme: Fibroblast mechanotransduction and matrix remodeling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover Rho-driven stress fiber and focal adhesion assembly, syndecan signalling and SRF-target cytoskeletal remodeling. This is the mechanosensing apparatus that drives YAP/TAZ-dependent matrix production, EMT-like stromal activation and fibroblast migration.

reading_2.theme: Fibroblast adhesion, cytoskeletal tension and matrix remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe focal adhesion, stress fibre and SRF-driven cytoskeletal signalling, framed as the mechanotransductive drivers of fibroblast migration, EMT and extracellular matrix assembly.

shared: regulation of very-low-density lipoprotein particle clearance
Assembly of active LPL and LIPC lipase complexes

reading_1.theme: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (chylomicrons, VLDL), framed as the plasma delivery of absorbed and hepatic lipid.

reading_2.theme: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism: chylomicrons and VLDL
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are VLDL and chylomicron assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance, the plasma processing of dietary and hepatic triglyceride carriers following intestinal lipid absorption.

shared: positive regulation of dendritic cell antigen processing and presentation
negative regulation of dendritic cell differentiation
antigen processing and presentation, endogenous lipid antigen via MHC class Ib
positive regulation of dendritic cell differentiation
CD4 T cell surface signature Th1-stimulated

reading_1.theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic lymphocyte activation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe dendritic cell differentiation, lipid (CD1) and protein antigen presentation, framed as the antigen-presenting side that activates T, NK and NKT cell responses and tolerance.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell and monocyte antigen presentation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame dendritic cell differentiation and antigen presentation, including CD1 lipid antigen presentation, as the functional output of the myeloid antigen-presenting identity defined by DC and monocyte surface signatures.

shared: myeloid cell enriched receptors and transporters

reading_1.theme: Immune cell-type surface marker signatures
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte, dendritic cell and antigen-presentation surface signatures, framed as myeloid antigen-presenting-cell identity markers contrasted with B cell surface signatures.

reading_2.theme: Surface marker signatures of antigen-presenting cells
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are surface receptor and transporter signatures of dendritic cells and monocytes, both resting and activated. They are read here as identity markers of antigen-presenting cell types, contrasted with B cell surface signatures.

shared: aspartate family amino acid biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Nitrogen metabolism, glutamate/aspartate and the urea cycle
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate metabolism and nitrogen utilisation, framed as the supply of ammonia and aspartate nitrogen into the urea cycle, whose enzyme and transporter defects make up the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Nitrogen metabolism: glutamate, aspartate and urea cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen handling, framed as the supplier of ammonia and aspartate nitrogen to the urea cycle and its disorders.

shared: Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) independent of the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, no-go decay
PELO:HBS1L and ABCE1 dissociate a ribosome on a non-stop mRNA
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) enhanced by the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)

reading_1.theme: Translation termination, ribosome quality control and translation factor modification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe translation termination, nonsense-mediated, non-stop and no-go mRNA decay, and diphthamide modification of eEF2, framed here as translational fidelity and surveillance alongside hypusination, hydroxylation and other factor modifications that tune elongation.

reading_2.theme: mRNA translation initiation, termination and quality control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination and ribosome/mRNA surveillance at stop codons and stalls (NMD, no-go, non-stop decay), the terminal and quality-control end of the translation cycle that begins with initiation.

shared: obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
Defective neurotransmitter clearance by SLC6A3 causes Parkinsonism-dystonia infantile (PKDYS)
obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
Defective transport of neurotransmitters by SLC6A3 causes Parkinsonism-dystonia infantile (PKDYS)

reading_1.theme: Dopaminergic neurotransmission, reward and psychostimulant response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic reuptake (DAT, NET), the supply and clearance that set synaptic dopamine and norepinephrine, framing dopamine receptor signalling, behaviour and psychostimulant responses.

reading_2.theme: Dopaminergic neurotransmission and psychostimulant response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic reuptake by DAT/NET transporters, framed as the control of synaptic dopamine levels that sets receptor signalling and is the target of cocaine and amphetamine.

reading_1.theme: tRNA processing and modification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame mitochondrial tRNA processing, 3'-end maturation and modification as the organellar branch of tRNA maturation alongside nuclear tRNA processing, splicing and fragment biogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA pseudouridylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial tRNA maturation (3'-end processing and base modification). Here this is one setting for pseudouridine synthase activity, which also modifies rRNA and mRNA.

shared: positive regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process
obsolete positive regulation of proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Bidirectional control of protein stability by proteasomal degradation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways promote ubiquitin-proteasome turnover and balance protein stabilisation against destabilisation (including RHOBTB2, a CUL3 ligase adaptor). The additional negative regulators act as the opposing brake, so together they tune protein half-life.

reading_2.theme: Regulation of proteasomal protein degradation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the promotion of ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and protein destabilization (plus stabilization), framed against negative regulation of proteolysis in the control of protein turnover.

reading_1.theme: PAX3/AP-2 transcriptional control of neural crest cadherins
reading_1.core_role: The shared PAX3 target sets frame PAX3 as the transcription factor whose targets, together with AP-2 and DNA-binding regulation, control cadherin (CDH1, CDH11, CDH19) expression in neural crest-derived cells.

reading_2.theme: PAX3 transcriptional targets
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 motif and target gene sets defining a transcription-factor regulon, here linked to ALK-driven nuclear events and PTEN transcription.

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA pseudouridylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial tRNA maturation (3'-end processing and base modification). Here this is one setting for pseudouridine synthase activity, which also modifies rRNA and mRNA.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA pseudouridylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial tRNA maturation, covering 3'-end processing and base modification, framed as part of RNA modification chemistry together with pseudouridine synthesis on tRNA, mRNA and rRNA.

shared: FASTK family proteins regulate processing and stability of mitochondrial RNAs
regulation of mitochondrial RNA catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial gene expression from RNA processing to translation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial mRNA modification, FASTK-mediated processing and stability, RNA decay control and large mitoribosome assembly. This is the post-transcriptional machinery enabling mitochondrial translation, alongside mtDNA replication.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial gene expression
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern mitochondrial RNA stability, modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, framed as the post-transcriptional stages following mitochondrial transcription with ribosome quality control.

shared: negative regulation of intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway by p53 class mediator
negative regulation of stress-activated protein kinase signaling cascade
negative regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator

reading_1.theme: Stress-induced senescence versus p53 apoptosis after DNA damage
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are a cell-fate decision under oxidative and genotoxic stress: they dampen p53-driven apoptosis and stress kinase signalling and send cells into premature senescence and proliferative arrest. Here the stress is UV-induced damage.

reading_2.theme: Stress-induced senescence and p53 damage-response restraint
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe oxidative stress-induced senescence with suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis and stress kinase signalling, framed as the cell-fate response to UV and DNA damage that favours arrest over death.

shared: Insulin-like Growth Factor-2 mRNA Binding Proteins (IGF2BPs/IMPs/VICKZs) bind RNA
positive regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay
negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay
M-decay: degradation of maternal mRNAs by maternally stored factors
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-independent decay
regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening
positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly

reading_1.theme: mRNA deadenylation, decay and stabilization
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cytoplasmic mRNA turnover (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay and IGF2BP-mediated stabilization), framed as the post-nuclear fate of transcripts whose poly(A) tails are set by 3'-end processing.

reading_2.theme: Post-transcriptional mRNA decay and small RNA silencing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cytoplasmic mRNA turnover machinery (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, stabilization), the effector step through which miRNA silencing and ARE-binding proteins regulate mRNA fate.

reading_1.theme: Regulation of TGF-beta receptor and SMAD signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe betaglycan (TGFBR3) as a co-receptor that presents or sequesters ligands for TGF-beta and FGF2 receptors, so they act as an upstream modulator setting the strength of SMAD signalling.

reading_2.theme: Betaglycan (TGFBR3) modulation of TGF-beta signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are TGFBR3 coreceptor function and its post-translational regulation, presenting and modulating TGF-beta (and FGF2) ligands upstream of SMAD signalling and its downregulation.

shared: co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway

reading_1.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA decay
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are pre-mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation, the nuclear 3'-end formation step, read here as the start of an mRNA life cycle that ends in decapping and 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay.

reading_2.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA turnover
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cleavage and polyadenylation of pre-mRNAs, framed as the 3'-end maturation step that is counterbalanced by decapping and exonucleolytic mRNA decay.

reading_1.theme: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are hexosamine pathway synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its congenital myasthenic syndrome defects, framed as the glycosylation precursor supply within amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism.

reading_2.theme: UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and nucleotide-sugar supply for glycosylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe hexosamine-pathway synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its defects (GFPT1, ALG14 myasthenic syndromes), framed here as the donor-substrate supply step that feeds Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporters whose defects cause congenital disorders of glycosylation.

shared: regulation of retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi

reading_1.theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde and recycling transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover bidirectional endosome-Golgi transport and Golgi protein retention. This is the sorting route within wider endosomal recycling, receptor return to the plasma membrane and lysosomal hydrolase delivery.

reading_2.theme: Golgi–endosome–lysosome membrane trafficking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are retrograde and anterograde transport between endosomes and the Golgi with Golgi retention, framed as trafficking routes that deliver cargo for lysosome biogenesis.

shared: ectopic germ cell programmed cell death
positive regulation of activin receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Germ cell and gonadal development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation, survival and meiotic entry, plus Leydig differentiation and AMH/activin signalling. This is gonadal maturation within germ cell specification and male sex determination.

reading_2.theme: Germ cell and gonad development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are germ cell migration, proliferation, survival and meiotic entry together with gonadal somatic signals (Leydig cell differentiation, AMH and activin), within primordial germ cell specification and testis determination.

shared: TP53 Regulates Transcription of DNA Repair Genes
Autodegradation of the E3 ubiquitin ligase COP1
Regulation of TP53 Activity through Phosphorylation

reading_1.theme: p53 regulation in DNA damage response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe phosphorylation- and ubiquitin-dependent control of p53 stability and activity (and Cdc25A degradation), framed as the DNA damage checkpoint signalling governed by kinase/phosphatase balance.

reading_2.theme: p53 and DNA damage checkpoint control of the cell cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame p53 regulation by phosphorylation and degradation, plus Cdc25A degradation, as the DNA-damage effectors that arrest the cell cycle at G2/M checkpoints.

shared: regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication initiation

reading_1.theme: Replication stress response and genome stability
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover resolving replication obstacles (DNA-protein crosslinks, R-loops, hydroxyurea and camptothecin responses) and origin firing, framed as protecting replication forks with fork reversal, topological changes and end-joining repair.

reading_2.theme: Replication stress and DNA damage response at stalled forks
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame replication-stress lesions (camptothecin/hydroxyurea damage, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks, origin firing control) as the damage that triggers PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, checkpoint signalling and break-site chromatin repair.

reading_1.theme: Sperm flagellar motility and microtubule-based structure
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways concern spermatogenesis and sperm motility, including mitochondrial sheath assembly, flagellar/ciliary beating and Sertoli barrier formation, here supported by kinesin- and microtubule-severing dynamics of the flagellar cytoskeleton.

reading_2.theme: Sperm flagellar motility and spermatogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath assembly, ciliary beating and the Sertoli cell barrier. These form the structural and energetic basis of the flagellum, supported by kinesins and microtubule severing and depolymerization.

shared: Anchoring of the basal body to the plasma membrane
de novo centriole assembly involved in multi-ciliated epithelial cell differentiation
positive regulation of non-motile cilium assembly

reading_1.theme: Cilium biogenesis, ciliary trafficking and motility
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the centriole and basal body foundation of cilia, centriole duplication, basal body docking and control of cilium assembly and disassembly, on which intraflagellar trafficking and motile axoneme function are built.

reading_2.theme: Centrosome and centriole organisation for cilia and spindles
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern centriole duplication, basal body anchoring and cilium assembly/disassembly, framed as the centrosome's interphase ciliary role, the counterpart of its mitotic role as microtubule-organising centre for spindle assembly and orientation.

shared: Erythrocytes take up carbon dioxide and release oxygen
Erythrocytes take up oxygen and release carbon dioxide
regulation of iron ion transmembrane transport
iron ion import across plasma membrane
Defective RHAG causes regulator type Rh-null hemolytic anemia (RHN)
Defective SLC11A2 causes hypochromic microcytic anemia, with iron overload 1 (AHMIO1)

reading_1.theme: Erythrocyte iron, heme and gas transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe red cell and systemic transport of iron, heme, oxygen, CO2 and ammonium (transferrin, ferroportin, Rh proteins) and their anemias, framed as the transport side of erythropoiesis and heme biosynthesis.

reading_2.theme: Erythrocyte gas, iron, heme and metal ion transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame red cell and systemic iron, heme, oxygen/CO2 and ammonium transport (and their disorders) as erythroid-centred solute handling within a broader programme of trace-metal transport and surfactant homeostasis.

shared: positive regulation of type I interferon-mediated signaling pathway
positive regulation of defense response to virus by host
IRF3-mediated induction of type I IFN
regulation of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly
IRF3 mediated activation of type 1 IFN

reading_1.theme: Cytosolic DNA sensing and antiviral type I interferon induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the effector outputs of cytosolic nucleic-acid sensors: IRF3-driven type I interferon, ZBP1/RIP-mediated NF-kB activation and AIM2 inflammasome assembly. They are how cGAS/STING-type DNA sensing becomes antiviral defense.

reading_2.theme: Cytosolic RNA sensing and type I interferon induction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the IRF3- and ZBP1/RIP-driven signalling that induces type I interferon and NF-kB, framed as the effector output of RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA sensing in antiviral defence.

shared: regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by endothelin
obsolete regulation of nitric oxide mediated signal transduction
negative regulation of receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway
negative regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure

reading_1.theme: NO/natriuretic peptide cGMP signalling controlling blood pressure
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover guanylyl-cyclase cGMP production and its outputs (vasodilation, natriuresis, diuresis, lower systemic and pulmonary pressure). Here they are the effector arm of eNOS-derived nitric oxide signalling that relaxes vascular smooth muscle.

reading_2.theme: Nitric oxide-cGMP and natriuretic control of blood pressure
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern cGMP-mediated lowering of blood pressure (vasodilation, natriuresis, diuresis, pulmonary pressure), the systemic vascular and renal output of eNOS-derived NO and guanylyl cyclase signalling that regulates smooth muscle tone.

shared: Apoptotic cleavage of cell adhesion  proteins

reading_1.theme: Cadherin-based cell-cell adhesion and junctions
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are adherens and apical junction adhesion structures, including their apoptotic cleavage, read here as the cadherin (CDH1/CDH11) calcium-dependent adhesion system whose trafficking and degradation are regulated.

reading_2.theme: Epithelial cell-cell junctions and adhesion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cell-cell adhesion and apical junction components, including their apoptotic cleavage, framed as the epithelial adherens-junction system and its maintenance.

shared: positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance
negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by netrin, Slit-Robo and ephrin signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are netrin-mediated attraction/repulsion and control of axon extension, alongside Slit-Robo and ephrin repulsion converging on Rho-GTPase cytoskeletal regulation.

reading_2.theme: Netrin, Slit/Robo and ephrin axon guidance signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are netrin-driven control of axon extension and chemorepulsion, the netrin branch of a guidance-receptor network that also includes Slit/Robo and ephrin repulsion converging on Rho GTPases.

shared: enriched in myeloid cells and monocytes
positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity
cellular response to oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle stimulus
complement and other receptors in DCs
Regulation of TLR by endogenous ligand

reading_1.theme: Myeloid innate inflammation via TLR and complement receptors
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe how monocytes and myeloid cells pick up danger signals (oxidised LDL, heme, endogenous TLR ligands) and turn them into an inflammatory response. The additional pathways carry this into complement-receptor signalling and neutrophil degranulation as effector outputs.

reading_2.theme: Monocyte/myeloid inflammatory activation by endogenous danger signals
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover TLR and scavenger-type sensing by monocytes and myeloid cells of endogenous ligands such as oxidized LDL and heme. They form the trigger of myeloid inflammatory signalling, extended by complement-receptor signalling and neutrophil degranulation.

shared: positive regulation of focal adhesion assembly

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes a mesenchymal, fibroblast-like programme in which mechanical and growth-factor cues are converted into matrix remodelling and stromal activation. Its hallmark outputs, the secreted matricellular proteins CCN1 and CCN2, are canonical readouts of YAP/TAZ activity downstream of cell stretch, stiffness and Rho signalling, and caveolin-1 links plasma-membrane mechanics to that response.

reading_1.theme: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast and stromal matrix remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe YAP/TAZ-mediated mechanosignalling, focal adhesion assembly and collagen/TGF-beta programmes, framed as the fibroblast activation that builds and remodels connective tissue matrix.

reading_2.theme: Fibroblast mechanotransduction, ECM remodelling and mesenchymal transition
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame mechanical and TGF-beta signalling at focal adhesions (YAP/TAZ-CCN1/CCN2, caveolin) as the stromal activation trigger that drives extracellular matrix production and epithelial-mesenchymal transition.

shared: innate activation by cytosolic DNA sensing

reading_1.theme: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cell-level antiviral responses to IFN-alpha and to cytosolic DNA (OAS, CXCL10/IP-10). They form the core of an interferon-stimulated gene signature that also includes ISG15 and IRF2 targets.

reading_2.theme: Type I interferon antiviral response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are virus and cytosolic DNA sensing and IFN-alpha effector responses (OAS, IP-10), framed as the innate antiviral interferon programme.

shared: Negative regulation of TCF-dependent signaling by DVL-interacting proteins

reading_1.theme: Axial mesoderm formation and convergent extension
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are notochord and axial mesoderm morphogenesis with apical constriction and Wnt/DVL regulation, the body-axis tissue shaped by planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension and patterned by Hedgehog signalling.

reading_2.theme: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension in axis formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are notochord and axial mesoderm morphogenesis, apical constriction and dampening of canonical Wnt/TCF signalling, framed as the tissue-shaping outcomes driven by non-canonical Wnt/PCP and Hedgehog signalling.

shared: mesenchymal stem cell maintenance involved in nephron morphogenesis
obsolete regulation of cell proliferation involved in kidney development
negative regulation of mesenchymal cell apoptotic process
negative regulation of apoptotic process involved in development
negative regulation of cell proliferation involved in kidney development

reading_1.theme: Kidney development: nephron progenitor and growth control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are control of nephron progenitor maintenance, proliferation, survival and kidney size, the growth-regulating core of metanephric development whose segments form tubules and ducts.

reading_2.theme: Kidney development from intermediate mesoderm
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern controlling nephron progenitor survival, proliferation and maintenance to set kidney size, framed as the metanephric mesenchyme side of reciprocal induction with the ureteric bud during nephrogenesis.

shared: establishment of protein localization to chromatin

reading_1.theme: Chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at DNA double-strand breaks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover nucleosome remodeling and assembly, PARP-driven ADP-ribosylation and recruitment of proteins to chromatin. Here they open and restore chromatin at DNA breaks so that DSB sensing and the choice between NHEJ and homologous recombination can proceed.

reading_2.theme: Chromatin assembly, histone acetylation and nucleosome remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleosome assembly and chromatin remodelling coupled to replication and repair, which this theme frames as the chromatin-structural substrate that histone acetylation, CHD remodellers and heterochromatin-focus formation act upon.

shared: Signaling by activated point mutants of FGFR3

reading_1.theme: FGF receptor signalling cascades
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe FGFR3 and FGFR1 ligand binding and FRS/SHC adaptor cascades including activating mutants, framed as canonical FGFR-to-MAPK signalling across all four receptors.

reading_2.theme: FGFR1/FGFR3 activation and downstream signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/FGFR3 ligand binding and FRS/SHC cascades, including activating FGFR3 mutants, framed as the receptor signal regulated by Spry and FGFRL1 feedback.

shared: Recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins and complexes
Loss of Nlp from mitotic centrosomes
Recruitment of NuMA to mitotic centrosomes

reading_1.theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle assembly
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are recruitment of proteins to mitotic centrosomes and AURKA activation, framed as centrosome maturation driving spindle formation and regulated by PLK1/AURKA and the spindle checkpoint.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover recruiting pericentriolar proteins and NuMA to mitotic centrosomes and activating Aurora A by TPX2. This builds the centrosome into the organizing hub that nucleates astral microtubules and assembles, positions and orients the mitotic spindle.

shared: positive regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle

reading_1.theme: E2F-driven cell cycle transcription
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are E2F transcriptional control of the G1/S transition, including E2F6-mediated repression, framed as the core transcriptional switch of the proliferation programme.

reading_2.theme: RB-E2F control of the G1/S cell-cycle transition
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F transcriptional network that drives G1/S entry, framed here as the output switch released when cyclin D/E-CDK activity inactivates RB1 and blocked by CDK4/6 inhibitors, p21/p27 and RB1-E2F checkpoint control.

shared: GRB2:SOS provides linkage to MAPK signaling for Integrins

[untitled BTM module] These genes converge on integrin-based adhesion and the cytoskeletal signalling that lets cells grip and respond to their extracellular matrix, with a supporting cast of metabolic and gene-regulatory proteins. Talin links activated integrin tails to actin, integrin-linked kinase couples the adhesion complex to downstream survival and contractility signalling, and a Rho GDP-dissociation inhibitor restrains Rho-family GTPases so that actin remodelling is switched rather than constant; a microtubule-associated protein and the SNARE-recycling factor alpha-SNAP tie the same events to cytoskeletal turnover and membrane fusion.
p130Cas linkage to MAPK signaling for integrins

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation via integrin and GPCR signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling and cytoskeletal remodelling via Rap1, talin, p130Cas and GRB2:SOS, the adhesion arm of platelet activation triggered by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and GPVI receptors.

reading_2.theme: Platelet activation and integrin signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling via Rap1, talin, p130Cas, GRB2:SOS and cytoskeletal remodelling, the adhesion and spreading machinery of activated platelets downstream of thrombin, ADP, GPVI and thromboxane receptors (hemostasis).

shared: Regulation of TBK1, IKKε-mediated activation of IRF3, IRF7 upon TLR3 ligation
positive regulation of defense response to virus by host
Evasion by RSV of host interferon responses
NF-kB activation through FADD/RIP-1 pathway mediated by caspase-8 and -10
Regulation of TBK1, IKKε (IKBKE)-mediated activation of IRF3, IRF7
IRF3-mediated induction of type I IFN
positive regulation of RIG-I signaling pathway
IRF3 mediated activation of type 1 IFN
positive regulation of type I interferon-mediated signaling pathway
SARS-CoV-2 activates/modulates innate and adaptive immune responses
Modulation of host responses by IFN-stimulated genes

reading_1.theme: RIG-I-like receptor and TLR3 signalling to type I interferon
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the full innate antiviral cascade (RLR/TLR3 sensing, TRAF3/6, TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/7 and NF-kB, viral evasion), framed as the signalling upstream of ISG15-mediated antiviral effector mechanisms.

reading_2.theme: RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing and type I interferon induction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cytosolic RNA-sensor cascade (RIG-I/MDA5, TRAF3/TRAF6, TBK1/IKKepsilon, IRF3/IRF7, NF-kB) plus its negative regulators and its evasion by viruses. This forms the interferon-inducing arm, whose stimulated-gene output includes ISG15 conjugation.

shared: regulation of mitochondrial RNA catabolic process
FASTK family proteins regulate processing and stability of mitochondrial RNAs

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial RNA processing and translation machinery
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial mRNA and rRNA modification, processing, stability and decay, together with mitoribosome subunit assembly. This is the core of mitochondrial gene expression, completed by mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial RNA processing and translation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial mRNA and rRNA fate, meaning mRNA stability and modification, FASTK-mediated processing, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly that enable mitochondrial translation, complemented by mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification.

shared: positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target

reading_1.theme: Notch receptor activation and target transcription
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-HLH target transcription, framed as the nuclear output that follows Notch receptor proteolytic activation.

reading_2.theme: Notch signalling and transcriptional regulation of targets
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-driven HLH target transcription, framed as the nuclear output of NOTCH1-4 intracellular domains in development, T helper differentiation and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants.

shared: Regulation of glycolysis by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate metabolism
Defective HK1 causes hexokinase deficiency (HK deficiency)

reading_1.theme: Glycolysis and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the glycolytic flux from glucose to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control (with oxygen transport), forming the glycolytic pathway itself that the additional regulators link to the pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide turnover.

reading_2.theme: Glycolysis and its regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glycolytic flux from glucose to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control (with erythrocyte context), the core glycolytic pathway regulated in balance with the pentose phosphate shunt.

shared: IRAK1 recruits IKK complex upon TLR7/8 or 9 stimulation
positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction
IKK complex recruitment mediated by RIP1

reading_1.theme: NF-kappaB activation and regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are canonical IKK recruitment downstream of TLR/IL-1R (IRAK1) and TNFR1 (RIP1), the core activation step of NF-kappaB signalling framed alongside noncanonical NF-kappaB, ubiquitin control and negative regulation.

reading_2.theme: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signalling and its regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover canonical IKK recruitment and NF-kB activation downstream of TLR/IRAK1 and RIP1, plus SUMOylation of immune proteins. This is the central activation step among TNFR1, CD40 and NIK-driven non-canonical signalling, ubiquitin control and IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies.

shared: negative regulation of Fas signaling pathway
positive regulation of extrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway via death domain receptors
SARS-CoV-1-mediated effects on programmed cell death
regulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells
positive regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process
negative regulation of tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway
Activation, myristolyation of BID and translocation to mitochondria
negative regulation of extrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway via death domain receptors
Microbial modulation of RIPK1-mediated regulated necrosis
negative regulation of hepatocyte apoptotic process

reading_1.theme: Apoptosis via death receptors and the mitochondrial pathway
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the extrinsic arm of cell death, death-receptor (Fas, TRAIL, TNF, TLR3/TRIF) signalling through caspase-8, c-FLIP and RIPK1 necroptosis, which via BID cleavage feeds the mitochondrial BCL-2/apoptosome execution pathway.

reading_2.theme: Apoptosis via extrinsic death receptors and mitochondria
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are death-receptor (Fas, TRAIL, TNF, TLR3/TRIF) caspase-8 signalling and its regulation (c-FLIP, necroptosis), the extrinsic initiating arm that feeds via BID into mitochondrial permeabilization and caspase execution.

shared: positive regulation of neuroepithelial cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Neural plate patterning and early neural induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe neural plate regionalization and neuroepithelial differentiation, framed as the core of early axial and border patterning that specifies anterior/posterior neural plate and neural crest.

reading_2.theme: Early neural plate and axial midline patterning
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe neural plate regionalisation and neuroepithelial differentiation, framed as neural tissue patterned by the notochord, floor plate and axial mesoderm midline signals in the early embryo.
